description: Dataset for Optimal Scheduling of an Integrated Gas–Electricity–Hydrogen Energy System Considering Hydrogen Blending into Natural Gas, published by Shen, Liang; Liu, Qingzhao; Niu, Pengtao; Lv, Muhao; Liang, Xiaoda; Liu, Chunying; Liang, Yongtu; Liao, Qi, packages synthetic gas, electricity and hydrogen scheduling inputs and outputs with reproducibility code. Coverage: A synthetic seven-bus electricity and ten-node gas network; four scenarios and a 3-by-3 sensitivity analysis. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: The seven-bus and ten-node networks are synthetic; they do not contain field measurements. Results reproduce one manuscript scenario design. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support optimisation, network flow studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
